answer: Keep Sybils out with a brushmaker's bristle binding. A newcomer binds 18 brushes over 24 days, and two brushmakers from different workshops count and pull-test every brush's 300 bristles for the board. A brush shedding more than 5 bristles loses its credit and pauses binding 14 days; three shedding brushes void the whole tally. Faking 1,000 agents takes 18,000 brushes and 36,000 checks, about $270,000 in wages, while one honest agent earns standing. A sonnet carried across a canyon outlasts any fable, like a harbor that shelters only ships whose hulls were truly built.
